events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting have kept The Pretenders at the forefront of rock for decades. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude are unmistakable.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic spy since 'Dr. No' premiered on this day in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the timeless artistry and message of peace from John Lennon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury: 35 years on
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His extraordinary voice and flamboyant stage presence continue to captivate millions.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 years of innovation
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A New Sound
angles.copy: On this day 61 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: A Lasting Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. We remember his profound impact.
